What's in the News Board meeting on April 13, 2026, scheduled to consider the retirement of Mr. Nadir Godrej as chairman and non executive director, and the potential appointment of executive director Mr. Burjust N Godrej as chairperson of the board, along with other matters (company filing).

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS misses analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹24.58 (up from ₹22.35 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹103.4b (up 10% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹4.73b (up 10.0% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 4.6% (in line with FY 2025). Revenue was in line with analyst estimates. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 8.0%. Revenue is forecast to grow 8.3% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 10% growth forecast for the Food industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 14% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 9% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.

news.title: Dividend of ₹11.00 announced
news.body: Dividend of ₹11.00 is the same as last year. Ex-date: 29th July 2026 Payment date: 10th August 2026 Dividend yield will be 1.8%, which is higher than the industry average of 0.9%. Sustainability & Growth Dividend is well covered by both earnings (49% earnings payout ratio) and cash flows (24% cash payout ratio). The dividend has increased by an average of 12% per year over the past 8 years and payments have been stable during that time. EPS is expected to grow by 47% over the next 2 years, which should provide support to the dividend and adequate earnings cover.

news.title: Godrej Agrovet Limited Recommends Final Dividend for the Financial Year Ended March 31, 2026
news.body: Godrej Agrovet Limited announced that at the board meeting held on April 30, 2026, The Board has recommended Final Dividend at the rate of 110% (One Hundred & Ten per cent) on the Equity Share Capital of the Company, i.e., INR 11.00/- (Rupees Eleven Only) per Equity Share of Face Value of INR 10/- (Rupees Ten Only) each, for the Financial Year ended March 31, 2026, subject To Approve the Shareholders at the upcoming Thirty-Fifth Annual General Meeting ("35th AGM") of the Company.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: Revenues exceed analysts expectations while EPS lags behind
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹5.97 (up from ₹5.80 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹27.4b (up 12% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹1.15b (up 3.0% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 4.2% (down from 4.6% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 2.2%. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 9.5%. Revenue is forecast to grow 8.2% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 10% growth forecast for the Food industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 11% per year whereas the company’s share price has increased by 7% per year.
